checkoutLayout: Clone the four repositories as siblings using their exact repository names; CentralPlatform generation scripts reference sibling repositories.
driverLocation: USE_TEST_LOCATION defaults to true for staging. For real GPS use --dart-define=USE_TEST_LOCATION=false.
signing: Use your own local signing configuration and authorized Apple development profile; signing keys and private build defines are not included.

pausedAt.completed: Baseline cash order delivered; financial reconciliation verified in CentralPlatform docs/cod-device-completion-168.json. Storefront delivery fee, preparation, minimum order, and delivery policy form redesign published to staging.
pausedAt.next: Create/send a Fattoush delivery offer with customer fee capped at 1500 IQD and platform support capped at 500 IQD, obtain real owner/authorized-manager consent, prepare a fresh one-order financial scope, then test delivery and reconcile.
pausedAt.expectedExample: For normal delivery 2000, goods 7000 and service 500: customer pays 9000, driver entitlement 2000 (cash retained 1500 plus wallet credit 500), driver hold 7500, merchant payable 6300, platform net contribution 700. This funded example is not a completed live test.
stillUnverified: Physical iOS Live Activity background lifecycle
pausedAt.latestPhysicalCustomerLaunch: Latest install succeeded but automatic launch was rejected by iOS signing/trust checks; local codesign verified. Recheck on the actual device.

credentials: Use your own GitHub/AWS access. Runtime secrets and /private/tmp deployment evidence are intentionally outside the repository.
deployment: A push is a source handoff. Do not rerun historical numbered publish/activation scripts blindly: many require private captured live artifacts and exact revision checks.
